description_en: Runs a synchronous command on one or more Cloud Phone instances and returns the execution result
description_zh: 执行云手机命令，并尝试返回结果
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic run-sync-command --instance-ids acp-5hh431emkt6u00000 --command-content ls --wait-time 1000 --content-encoding PlainText --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunSyncCommand

parameters.help_en: An array of Cloud Phone instance IDs. You can specify up to 50 instances in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例ID列表。一次请求最多支持50个实例
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The content of the command to execute
parameters.name: command_content

parameters.help_en: The timeout for command execution, in milliseconds. Valid range: 500 to 3000. Default: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 等待时间，单位为毫秒。取值范围500\~3000，默认值为1000
parameters.name: wait_time

parameters.help_en: The encoding of the command content. If you provide a value that is not a valid option, the system uses the default value, `PlainText`
parameters.help_zh: 脚本内容的编码方式。若该参数传入的值不在枚举值范围内，则一律视为传入默认值`PlainText`
parameters.name: content_encoding
